question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Full query: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers
-- (first movie = earliest payment date per customer), compute:
-- - average total amount spent per customer
-- - average number of subsequent rentals (total rentals - 1)

WITH payment_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.rental_id,
        p.payment_date,
        r.inventory_id,
        f.rating
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
    WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
),
first_rental AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        rental_id,
        payment_date,
        inventory_id,
        rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date ASC) AS rn
    FROM payment_rental
),
customer_first_movie AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rating
    FROM first_rental
    WHERE rn = 1
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r WHERE r.customer_id = p.customer_id) AS total_rentals
    FROM payment p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cfm.rating,
    AVG(ct.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount_spent,
    AVG(ct.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM customer_first_movie cfm
JOIN customer_totals ct ON cfm.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY cfm.rating
ORDER BY cfm.rating;
